artifact: adversarial prior-art panel on the lambda_2 priority claim
verdict: PRIOR ART FOUND -- PARTIAL. The priority claim survives on precision but its precedent number is wrong and two qualifiers are load-bearing and currently absent. Sub-question 1 (has anyone computed Maass eigenvalues on hyperbolic 3-manifolds): PRIOR ART FOUND, abundantly, an eight-item literature 1991-2025. Sub-question 2 (to what precision): PRIOR ART FOUND at 13 decimal places / 14 significant digits (Aurich-Steiner-Then 2004, Picard orbifold ground state r = 6.6221193402528); B922's 25 decimals still leads by 12. Sub-question 3 (the figure-eight complement / r = 4.9000853... specifically): NO PRIOR ART AT THE DEPTH SEARCHED, subject to the pullback caveat below.

verdict_on_repo_precedent_number.evidence: Aurich-Steiner-Then, arXiv:gr-qc/0404020, section 8, verbatim: 'The smallest non-trivial eigenvalue is E = k^2 + 1 with k = 6.6221193402528'. Identical value in Then, arXiv:math-ph/0305048.
verdict_on_repo_precedent_number.nuance: '~10' fairly describes the TABULATED data (8 decimal places throughout Tables 1-2, i.e. 9-11 significant digits) but understates the single best published number by ~4 digits. Three honest tiers exist: 5 decimals independently cross-checked (Steil <-> Then), 8 decimals systematically tabulated across 13950 eigenvalues, 13 decimals printed once for the ground state with no error bar.

verdict_on_h2_side_claim.source: Booker, Strombergsson, Venkatesh, 'Effective computation of Maass cusp forms', IMRN 2006, DOI 10.1155/imrn/2006/71281
verdict_on_h2_side_claim.verbatim: we compute to over 1000 decimal places the Laplacian and Hecke eigenvalues for the first few Maass forms on PSL(2,Z)\H ... we apply this to prove that our values for the first ten eigenvalues on PSL(2,Z)\H are correct to at least 100 decimal places
verdict_on_h2_side_claim.caveat: 1000 computed but only 100 rigorously certified. If the arc quotes 1000 it should carry this distinction, since B922's own 25 digits are stability-certified rather than rigorously verified in the BSV sense.

figure_eight_specific.finding: CAVEAT THE ARC MUST ABSORB -- published spectral data for m004's Laplacian DOES exist, by pullback, at 5-6 significant digits.
figure_eight_specific.mechanism: Gamma_41 is contained in PSL(2,O_3) with index 12 (repo's own B790, by Humbert volume), so every published parent eigenvalue IS an eigenvalue of the figure-eight knot complement

published_pullback_values.source: De Clerck, Hartnoll, Yang, arXiv:2507.08788 (2025), Fig. 4 caption: 'the first 1000 c_p associated to the Eisenstein waveform at epsilon = 24.5033'
published_pullback_values.convention_verified: their eq. (27) defines -Laplacian psi = (1 + epsilon^2) psi, so epsilon IS the spectral parameter r; the Eisenstein billiard is PSL(2,Z[omega]) = PSL(2,O_3), the exact parent group
published_pullback_values.note: the repo already banks this as its literature control; the panel confirms both the transcription and the convention from the primary
SECONDARY ONLY -- the primary remains unread, see unreachable_sources

figure_eight_specific.why_the_b922_claim_survives_anyway: r = 4.9000853... cannot be a pullback: the parent's ground state sits at r = 7.07 > 4.90, so no parent eigenvalue lies below it. B922's lambda_2 is a genuinely new, non-inherited eigenvalue of the index-12 cover.
figure_eight_specific.sentence_that_must_not_be_repeated: 'm004's Maass spectrum has never been computed' -- false by pullback. The defensible form is 'no eigenvalue of m004 not inherited from its parent Bianchi group has previously been computed'.

near_misses.what_it_computed: low-lying Laplace eigenvalues on a large family of CLOSED hyperbolic 3-MANIFOLDS (Thurston, Weeks, ...) by boundary-element and periodic-orbit-sum methods
near_misses.why_it_matters: these are genuine hyperbolic 3-manifolds, so the phrase 'on any hyperbolic 3-manifold' as written does not exclude them. They are not cusp forms (closed implies no cusps), which is exactly why 'cusped' / 'Maass cusp form' is load-bearing.

near_misses.residual_risk: LOW and method-bounded: a collocation method whose stated purpose is confirming a correspondence and testing a Waldspurger-type link, not producing a precision eigenvalue table

safe_claim_forms: The second Maass cusp form eigenvalue of the figure-eight knot complement, r = 4.9000853730625213014795758, to 25 decimal places -- improving the precedent for a Maass eigenvalue on a quotient of H^3 from 13 decimal places (Aurich-Steiner-Then 2004, Picard orbifold ground state) to 25, and the first eigenvalue computed for this manifold that is not inherited from its parent Bianchi group PSL(2,O_3).
The highest-precision Maass eigenvalue computed on any quotient of hyperbolic 3-space: 25 decimal places, against a published precedent of 13.
A 12-decimal-place improvement on the published precision record for Maass eigenvalues on quotients of H^3.
unsafe_claim_forms: the first 25-digit Maass eigenvalue on any hyperbolic 3-manifold -- the numeral 25 does no comparative work; the reader cannot tell whether the precedent is 3 or 24 [the phrase itself is registered retracted (B943) and appears here only as the record of what was claimed, never as a live claim]
H^3 had reached ~10 -- factually wrong; the published figure is 13 decimal places
m004's Maass spectrum has never been computed -- false by index-12 pullback from PSL(2,O_3)
no Laplace eigenvalue has been computed on a hyperbolic 3-manifold -- false; Inoue 1999/2001 did so for many closed ones
any form whose survival depends on the manifold-versus-orbifold distinction
residual_open_items: Grunewald-Huntebrinker 1996 Table 3 remains unread (paywalled). The repo's open lead B921-17 is confirmed still open and is still the single highest-value external action.
Steil 1999 (Springer book chapter) unread; precision bounded only indirectly.
MathSciNet not reached (authentication wall); no claim is made about its contents.

All three unread computational items predate 2005 and use methods (finite elements, non-linear Hecke systems, collocation) that do not plausibly reach 25 decimal places. The 2005-2026 window was swept independently and contains exactly one new computational item, at 6 significant digits.
